senses.gloss: m. (אֲלַל; cmp. b. h. דָּרַךְ) treading the wine or olive press; quantity put into the press at a time.
units: B. Mets. 105ᵃ הא באתרא … בא׳ Ar. (ed. או׳) the one Rabbi treats of a place where they ordinarily put one khor (measure) into the press at a time, &c.

Esth. R. to I, 2 (referring to Esth. l. c., and Neh. XIII, 15 ‘in those days’; play on al’la a. al’lay; v. next w.) א׳ וּוַי וכ׳ ‘wine pressing’ (on Sabbath, Neh. l. c.) and ‘woe’ (persecution as punishment) were those days marked for.
